intent: Eight original volunteer-notice tasks derive 13:50 arrival and 80-minute duration from different scopes, select opposite welcome-desk/marked-shelf pictures, preserve only-if permission, combine private-document handling requirements, distinguish before-Sunday notice from early Sunday arrival and connect actual needs with useful help. Fresh Saturday transfer changes the start and advance interval to 16:00 minus 15 minutes, with partly correct combination distractors.
picturePurpose: Original welcome desk versus low bookshelf supplies location identities; coded labels identify the large-print area. Blank book covers do not establish actual print size. The text supplies schedule, permission, role and privacy instructions.

workshop.title: 帮对忙，也要看清条件：读懂志愿者通知
workshop.instruction: 按通知算到场时间，再匹配需求与地点；条件、文件处理和提前说明要分别核对。

items.label: 活动开始和提前到场要分开
items.prompt: What arrival time does the notice give volunteers?
items.answer: 13:50, ten minutes before the 14:00 event start.
items.reason: 活动14:00开始，志愿者提前10分钟到场，所以是13:50。15:20是结束时间，不能拿结束时间往前减来算到场时间。
items.hint: 分清活动时间与志愿者到场时间，再核对地点、请求条件和需要提前说明的事。
items.material:
VOLUNTEERS AT THE BOOK EXCHANGE
The book exchange runs on Sunday afternoon from 14:00 to 15:20.
Please arrive ten minutes before the event begins.
The short introduction takes place at the welcome desk.
For large-print books, guide visitors to the marked shelf.
Carry a visitor's books only if they ask you to.
Give any personal documents you find to the adult organiser.
Do not read or copy them, and do not show them to other visitors.
If you can stay for only part of the event, tell the organiser before Sunday.
Begin by asking what help a visitor wants.
Useful help responds to people's needs, rather than only following the helper's guesses.

transfer.passage:
HELPERS AT SATURDAY READING HOUR
The event runs from 16:00 to 17:10 on Saturday. Helpers should arrive fifteen minutes before the event starts for a short introduction. Give any personal papers you find in donated books privately to the adult organiser. Do not read them or share them with visitors. Helpers who can stay for only part of the event should tell the organiser before Saturday.
transfer.stem: Which volunteer plan follows all these instructions?

options.text: Arrive at 16:00 for the introduction, pass personal papers privately to the organiser, and give notice before Saturday if staying only part.
Arrive at 15:45, pass personal papers privately to the organiser, and give notice before Saturday if staying only part.
Arrive at 15:45, let visitors read personal papers before handing them over, and give notice before Saturday if staying only part.

answer.display: Arrive at 15:45, pass personal papers privately to the organiser, and give notice before Saturday if staying only part.
